extension.title: Terminal Any Encoding
extension.description: Use non-UTF-8 character encodings (Windows-1252, ISO-8859-1, Windows-1251, KOI8-R, Shift JIS, EUC-JP, GBK, Big5, EUC-KR, and the rest of the 45 non-Unicode encodings VS Code natively supports) in the VS Code integrated terminal.
command.openTerminal.title: Open Terminal with Encoding...
config.defaultEncoding.description: Encoding used by "Open Terminal (Default Encoding)" and the "🌐 Default Encoding" terminal profile. Leave empty to choose one each time.
config.warnAboutLocale.description: Warn when a terminal can't use a locale matching its encoding: the host has none installed, or an LC_* variable in the environment names a different encoding. Programs in such a terminal may print garbled text.
config.shellProfile.linux.description: The terminal profile (a name from `#terminal.integrated.profiles.linux#`) whose shell runs inside this extension's terminals on Linux. Leave empty to use `#terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.linux#`; if that's one of this extension's profiles, `$SHELL` is used.
config.shellProfile.osx.description: The terminal profile (a name from `#terminal.integrated.profiles.osx#`) whose shell runs inside this extension's terminals on macOS. Leave empty to use `#terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.osx#`; if that's one of this extension's profiles, `$SHELL` is used.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: In Restricted Mode, the terminal profile set by a workspace (shellProfile) is ignored, as VS Code ignores a workspace's terminal profiles.
taskDefinition.encoding.description: Encoding the task's shell runs in, as in "Open Terminal with Encoding...".
taskDefinition.command.description: The command to run, as in a "shell" task. Without `args`, it's a whole command line.
taskDefinition.args.description: Arguments passed to the command, quoted for the shell.
taskDefinition.options.cwd.description: The working directory. Defaults to the workspace folder.
taskDefinition.options.env.description: Environment variables added for the task.
